subject: MBTA Communities Zoning Ordinance
overview: The committee held an informational session on proposed zoning compliance under the state's MBTA Communities Act, focusing on a planned overlay district around Wellington Station. Planning staff and consultants reviewed district boundaries, density requirements, and height incentives ahead of upcoming public hearings.

items.title: MBTA Communities Zoning Presentation and Discussion
items.summary: Consultant Emily Innes and planning staff presented draft zoning for a multi-family overlay district at Wellington Station to meet the state mandate of 6,443 units of zoned capacity, explaining baseline five-story limits and incentive bonuses up to nine stories. Council members asked questions regarding site plan review authority, existing unit counts in the district, and the pending economic feasibility study required to apply the city's local inclusionary zoning standards.
